title: Inspect and export discovered companies and jobs
summary: Read retained companies, jobs, historical collection outcomes and coverage. Export a consistent JSON snapshot for downstream selection. Cast performs no collection.
use_when: A caller needs stored companies and jobs or the timestamps, limits and outcomes of historical collection work.
A downstream product needs a consistent machine-readable discovery snapshot.
do_not_use_when: Current remote sources must be fetched; Cast no longer provides collection.
The caller needs a personal recommendation or application workflow.
outcome: Retained discovery records or one consistent JSON snapshot carrying stable identities, revisions, evidence and collection coverage.
effects: Reads retained Cast state without fetching external sources or running a model. Output may disclose private query interests, posting text and source locators.
An explicit export --output writes and atomically replaces a private caller-selected file; stdout reads do not write an export.
authority: Cast owns stored company and job identities, revisions, source metadata and read projections.
Consumers own filtering, consumed revisions, packet state and notification history.
success: The requested read completes against supported initialized state. Export returns a consistent snapshot with its schema version, revision, capture time, companies, jobs, source health and query coverage.
failure_and_recovery: An empty result contains no stored records matching the selected query and limits.
Reads do not refresh information. Cast has no collection interface. Use state reconcile-ownership for the documented local ownership correction; do not inspect or repair SQLite directly.
privacy: CLI output and exported snapshots are private caller-owned data. Reads send no information to remote systems.
does_not_authorize: Selecting jobs for the user, creating CRM cases or application packets, sending email, submitting applications, invoking an agent or browser, or enabling a schedule.
Fetching sources during a read operation.

consumers.statement: Local callers and downstream products can inspect retained discovery evidence and consume consistent exports.

preconditions.statement: The selected state directory contains a supported initialized Cast database and the requested identity or command is valid.

inputs.statement: Inputs are one selected state directory, a supported read command and optional record identity.

outputs.statement: CLI reads use readable text by default: compact list/search rows with a more-results notice, complete show fields, and labeled status or snapshot results. Global --json selects the existing JSON schemas. JSON list and search return schema-two pages with snapshot_revision, compact items and has_more. The default limit is 20 items; --limit accepts a positive integer. Job rows contain stable ID and revision, company, title, location, remote eligibility, recorded availability and last_seen_at. Search adds matched_field and a marked excerpt of at most 240 Unicode characters. Status returns counts, budgets, usage, the last run and collection summaries for sources and queries. Show and export return full records, source metadata and collection outcomes. The export snapshot still uses schema 1. Export --output always writes a JSON snapshot artifact; --json selects only its stdout receipt format. Operational errors exit 1: text on stderr by default, or schema-one ok:false with error.detail on stderr with --json. Syntax errors remain Clap text on stderr with exit 2. The status-snapshot --json protocol and native Rust APIs remain unchanged.

data_semantics.statement: Reads and exports include all retained jobs without a title substring requirement. Job counts describe retained records rather than all postings available from external sources. Consumers choose jobs by title, seniority, location or other preferences.

Revisions track retained record changes; observation dates, source-provided dates, job availability and collection health remain separate. Stored relevance reasons describe discovery signals rather than personal recommendations.

Description excerpts are capped at 1,200 characters. Retained unknown, listed, unlisted, missing and presumed_closed values describe historical collection evidence. Historical presumed_closed required at least two complete missing scans and 24 hours since the first absence. Cast no longer scans or updates availability from external sources.

identity_and_units.statement: Company, job and source IDs are opaque Cast identities. A snapshot revision identifies stored state at export. ATS sources use canonical provider/tenant owners independently of linking website candidates. Ownership correction can change a job's company_id and revision while preserving job and source IDs. Matching company names alone do not cause a merge.
Reads define no billing or physical unit.

completeness_and_freshness.statement: Export is one consistent view of all retained companies, jobs and historical collection records. captured_at describes snapshot capture; record dates describe retained observations. Source timestamps describe historical ordinary board collection. Historical targeted job observations changed the selected job and run record while preserving board-scan state; retained run notes describe their scope and outcome.
Read operations return stored records without fetching source URLs. Cast has no collection commands. The unused current model does not replace these reads or establish current source availability.

access.statement: Supported consumers use the local CLI or the provider-owned Rust read surface cast::store::Store::open and Store::snapshot, returning cast::models::Snapshot. Direct SQLite is not a consumer boundary.

lifecycle_and_consistency.statement: A snapshot reads within one database transaction and starts no collection work. Separate reads need not share a snapshot.

operational_limits.statement: The export returns retained current records rather than a durable event stream or consumer acknowledgement protocol.
No maximum database size, export size or read-latency service level is promised.

compatibility_and_evolution.statement: Read contract version 3 and export schema 1 are independent of the Cast package version. Reads include all retained jobs without a title constraint.
No future deprecation window is promised.

reliances.statement: Reads use only Cast retained local state. Source locators are stored evidence and cause no remote call.
